The shop is open from nine in the morning to nine at night.
这家商店从早上九点营业到晚上九点。
Mrs. Green has taught English at our school for ten years.
格林太太在我们学校教英语已经十年了。
quite a few: Quite a few students in my class went to the summer camp.
我们班相当多的学生去了夏令营。
paragliding: My uncle tried paragliding by the sea last summer and loved it.
我叔叔去年夏天在海边尝试了滑翔伞运动,并且喜欢上了它。
feel like(doing sth.): I feel like drinking something hot on such a cold winter morning.
在这么冷的冬天早晨,我想喝点热的东西。
because of: The football match was put off because of the heavy rain.
因为大雨,足球比赛被推迟了。
have a good time: We had a good time singing and dancing at the party last night.
昨天晚上我们在聚会上又唱又跳,玩得很开心。
Central Park: They took a walk in Central Park after visiting the museum nearby.
参观完附近的博物馆后,他们在中央公园散了散步。
Huangguoshu waterfall: Huangguoshu Waterfall is one of the most famous waterfalls in China.
黄果树瀑布是中国最著名的瀑布之一。
Hong Kong: My aunt works in Hong Kong and comes home twice a year.
我姑姑在香港工作,一年回家两次。
Malaysia: Malaysia is a warm country in Southeast Asia with many beautiful islands.
马来西亚是东南亚一个温暖的国家,有许多美丽的岛屿。
Georgetown: We visited Georgetown last year and enjoyed walking along its old streets.
去年我们游览了乔治城,很喜欢在那些老街上散步。
Weld Quay: There are many famous old restaurants along Weld Quay in Penang.
槟城的海乾街沿线有许多有名的老餐馆。
Penang Hill: It took us two hours to climb Penang Hill, but the view was great.
我们花了两个小时爬槟榔山,但山顶的风景很美。
tian'anmen square: Thousands of visitors watch the national flag rise at Tian'anmen Square every morning.
每天早晨,成千上万的游客在天安门广场观看升国旗。
the Palace Museum: The Palace Museum attracts millions of visitors from all over the world every year.
故宫博物院每年吸引来自世界各地的数百万游客。
hardly ever: He hardly ever eats breakfast before going to school in the morning.
他早上上学前几乎从不吃早饭。
swing dance: My grandparents learned swing dance when they were young and still enjoy it.
我的祖父母年轻时学会了摇摆舞,现在仍然很喜欢。
junk food: Eating too much junk food like chips and hamburgers is bad for your health.
吃太多薯片、汉堡之类的垃圾食品对你的健康有害。
such as: I like many fruits, such as apples, bananas and grapes.
我喜欢很多水果,例如苹果、香蕉和葡萄。
more than: More than two hundred students joined the English club this term.
这学期有两百多名学生加入了英语俱乐部。
less than: The whole trip took less than an hour by high-speed train.
乘高铁,整个行程花了不到一个小时。
loudly: Don't talk so loudly in the library; other people are reading.
在图书馆里不要这么大声说话,别人在看书。
care about: Good friends always care about each other and help in hard times.
好朋友总是互相关心,在困难时互相帮助。
as long as: You can borrow my bike as long as you return it before Friday.
只要你在星期五之前还回来,就可以借我的自行车。
be different from: Life in the countryside is quite different from life in big cities.
乡村的生活和大城市的生活大不相同。
bring out: Hard times can bring out the best in a person.
艰难的时节能激发出一个人最好的一面。
the same as: My schoolbag is the same as my sister's, so we often mix them up.
我的书包和我姐姐的一样,所以我们经常拿错。
in fact: Everyone thought he was shy, but in fact he just liked listening.
大家都以为他害羞,其实他只是喜欢倾听。
be similar to: Your handwriting is similar to mine, so the teacher sometimes mixes them up.
你的笔迹和我的很相似,所以老师有时会把它们弄混。
primary school: My little brother will go to primary school next September.
我弟弟明年九月就要上小学了。
carefully: Please read the questions carefully before you answer them on the paper.
在纸上答题之前,请仔细阅读题目。
so far: So far, we have planted more than three hundred trees around our school.
到目前为止,我们已经在学校周围种了三百多棵树。
have…in common: Although they are twins, the two brothers have little in common.
虽然他们是双胞胎,但兄弟俩几乎没有什么共同之处。
all kinds of: The market sells all kinds of fresh vegetables at low prices.
这个市场以低廉的价格出售各种各样的新鲜蔬菜。
be up to: It is up to you to decide where we will go this weekend.
这个周末我们去哪儿由你来决定。
play a role: Parents play an important role in their children's education.
父母在孩子的教育中起着重要作用。
make up: Don't make up an excuse; just tell the teacher why you were late.
不要编造借口,直接告诉老师你为什么迟到。
for example: Many sports, for example swimming and running, help you stay healthy.
许多运动,例如游泳和跑步,有助于保持健康。
take…seriously: You should take your study seriously if you want to pass the exam.
如果你想通过考试,就应该认真对待学习。
